intro.title: Life Wheel Assessment
intro.subtitle: 60 Questions. 10 Minutes. Your Starting Point.
intro.permanentWarningTitle: This assessment is permanent and cannot be retaken
intro.permanentWarningDesc: Your results become your baseline for all future transformations.
intro.answerHonestlyTitle: Answer honestly - this is just your baseline. You'll improve from here.
intro.answerHonestlyDesc: This assessment creates your starting point across 6 life areas. There are no wrong answers - we're measuring where you are now, not where you should be. Your transformation journey begins with this honest snapshot.
intro.yesNoFormat: Simple YES/NO format for honest answers
intro.instantScoringDesc: Each area gets a score from 0-10 based on your responses
intro.identifiesFocusDesc: Your lowest scoring area becomes your first transformation priority
intro.beHonestDesc: Your authentic answers create the most effective transformation plan
intro.thinkRecentDesc: Base answers on your last 3-6 months, not your best or worst days
intro.noJudgmentDesc: Low scores aren't failures - they're opportunities for growth
intro.startingLineDesc: Every transformation journey needs a clear beginning point
intro.step1: Your personalized Life Wheel is generated
intro.step2: We identify your priority area for transformation
intro.step3: You can create your first 90-day Project
intro.timeInvestmentDesc: Most people complete this assessment in 8-12 minutes. Take your time - there's no rush.
intro.cannotGoBack: You cannot go back once started
intro.cannotGoBackDesc: This assessment is designed to capture an honest moment in time. When you begin, commit to completing it and move forward. You'll be able to retake or reassess past this first baseline.
intro.allCompletedDesc: Congratulations! You've completed your Life Wheel assessment. Now you can view your personalized Life Wheel and start creating projects in your lowest scoring areas.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: Can I change plans at any time?
faq.a1: Yes! You can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time. Changes will affect your next billing cycle.
faq.q2: What happens if I cancel my subscription?
faq.a2: Your data is always yours. If you cancel, you'll retain access until the end of your billing period, and your data will be safely stored if you decide to return.
faq.a3: The BASICO plan gives you access to core features to get started. You can upgrade anytime as your needs grow.
